# Project Title: AI-Powered Sales Funnel Optimization and Conversion Rate Prediction using Pandas, LightGBM, and SHAP Explainability
# Project Reference: ai-ml-ds-ZkT9xgF3qLp
# File Name: ai_powered_sales_funnel_optimization.py

# ---------------------- IMPORTS ----------------------
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
import shap
import joblib
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, roc_auc_score, confusion_matrix
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin

# ---------------------- GLOBALS ----------------------
SEED: int = 42
pd.options.mode.chained_assignment = None
np.random.seed(SEED)

# ---------------------- CUSTOM TRANSFORMERS ----------------------
class FeatureDropper(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    def __init__(self, drop_cols: list[str]):
        self.drop_cols = drop_cols

    def fit(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y=None):
        return self

    def transform(self, X: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return X.drop(columns=self.drop_cols, errors='ignore')

# ---------------------- LOAD DATA ----------------------
def load_data() -> pd.DataFrame:
    from sklearn.datasets import fetch_openml
    df: pd.DataFrame = fetch_openml("ecommerce-sales-conversion", version=1, as_frame=True).frame
    return df

# ---------------------- DATA CLEANING ----------------------
def preprocess_data(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.Series]:
    df = df.copy()
    y: pd.Series = df["converted"]
    X: pd.DataFrame = df.drop(columns=["converted", "user_id", "timestamp"])
    return X, y

# ---------------------- FEATURE ENGINEERING ----------------------
def create_pipeline(X: pd.DataFrame) -> Pipeline:
    numeric_features: list[str] = X.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    categorical_features: list[str] = X.select_dtypes(include=["object", "category"]).columns.tolist()

    numeric_pipeline = Pipeline([
        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="mean")),
        ("scaler", StandardScaler())
    ])

    categorical_pipeline = Pipeline([
        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
        ("encoder", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"))
    ])

    preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
        ("num", numeric_pipeline, numeric_features),
        ("cat", categorical_pipeline, categorical_features)
    ])

    return preprocessor

# ---------------------- MODEL TRAINING ----------------------
def train_model(X_train: pd.DataFrame, y_train: pd.Series, preprocessor: Pipeline) -> Pipeline:
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(random_state=SEED, n_jobs=-1)
    pipeline = Pipeline([
        ("preprocessor", preprocessor),
        ("classifier", model)
    ])

    param_grid = {
        "classifier__n_estimators": [100, 300],
        "classifier__max_depth": [7, 15],
        "classifier__learning_rate": [0.01, 0.1]
    }

    grid_search = GridSearchCV(pipeline, param_grid, cv=3, scoring="roc_auc", verbose=1)
    grid_search.fit(X_train, y_train)

    return grid_search.best_estimator_

# ---------------------- MODEL EVALUATION ----------------------
def evaluate_model(model: Pipeline, X_test: pd.DataFrame, y_test: pd.Series) -> None:
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
    y_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    print("\nClassification Report:\n", classification_report(y_test, y_pred))
    print("ROC AUC:", roc_auc_score(y_test, y_proba))
    print("Confusion Matrix:\n", confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred))

# ---------------------- SHAP EXPLAINABILITY ----------------------
def shap_explainer(model: Pipeline, X_sample: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    preprocessed: np.ndarray = model.named_steps["preprocessor"].transform(X_sample)
    explainer = shap.Explainer(model.named_steps["classifier"])
    shap_values = explainer(preprocessed)
    shap.summary_plot(shap_values, X_sample)

# ---------------------- RUN PIPELINE ----------------------
def main():
    df: pd.DataFrame = load_data()
    X, y = preprocess_data(df)
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=SEED)
    pipeline = create_pipeline(X_train)
    model = train_model(X_train, y_train, pipeline)
    evaluate_model(model, X_test, y_test)
    shap_explainer(model, X_test.sample(100, random_state=SEED))
    joblib.dump(model, "sales_funnel_model.pkl")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
